trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer connection pooling for dashboard performance
trello.desc: Dashboard is slow for accounts with lots of projects. Profiling shows ~80% of time is waiting on database due to connection contention, not query cost. Decision made to stay on Postgres, no MongoDB migration or evaluation. Owner to set up a load test mirroring the dashboard's query pattern and benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against current setup. Compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer and bring numbers to next sync. This addresses connection contention instead of database migration, which was rejected due to migration cost and reporting dependency on SQL joins from 18 months ago assessment by Tom and Nadia agreement to stay on Postgres with no evaluation task on the board.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc: Marketing spotted typo 'recieve' in onboarding email subject line. Owner to fix typo to 'receive' in the email template repo, push fix today, and get it re-approved. Described as a five-minute job.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc for dark mode delivery
trello.desc: Roadmap doc still shows dark mode under 'Q3 committed' which is now incorrect. Decision: do not build dark mode this cycle. Dark mode will come for free with the September design-system upgrade which ships with theming built in, tokens, dark palette. Owner to move dark mode entry under the September design-system upgrade line in the roadmap doc so sales stops promising it as a standalone commitment. If anyone asks about dark mode, communicate it is delivered via September design-system upgrade, not as a separate three-week build by Raj and Tom. Original proposal for Raj to build theme system and Tom to do asset variants is scratched due to design-system upgrade overlap.
